proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F _ _ _ _ T S hT h
  have h1 : IsCompactOperator (S.comp T) := hT.clm_comp S
  rw [h] at h1
  exact isCompactOperator_id_iff_finiteDimensional.mp h1
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (T : E →L[𝕜] F) (S : F →L[𝕜] E), IsCompactOperator T → S.comp T = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 E → FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E
